structuredContent.name: tenants.list-tenants
structuredContent.description: List the tenants visible to the caller, ordered by tenant identifier: every tenant for a global administrator, otherwise only the tenants the caller is a member of. Each item gives the tenant identifier, name and status (Active or Disabled). Results are paged: pageSize takes 1 to 100 (default 20, larger values are reduced to 100); to read the next page, pass the returned next-page cursor as the cursor argument: it is the result document's cursor, also reported as paging.nextCursor when a paging argument was sent. offset is not supported.

Cursor.description: Has no effect: use the pageSize and cursor call arguments instead.

PageSize.description: Has no effect: use the pageSize and cursor call arguments instead.
